review_description: From initial quote to final installation, the whole process was seamless. Very honest and upfront. Easy process. Not pushy. Install very effecient. Works flawlessly.

I researched many solar installers before finally deciding to go with Spark and I'm so glad I made the right choice. Daniel and his team are proper experts, friendly and professional and took the time to explain everything from options before the install to how and why every component was installed after the job was done. Customer service like this is rare these days so it stands out when you experience it. I can't recommend Spark highly enough and wouldn't hesitate to encourage anyone to trust them with what is not a simple or small investment.

We upgraded our 3kW system for a new 6.6kW system. Daniel provided advice on removal of the old system as well as the most suitable new one. Daniel made an on site inspection while other suppliers relied on aerial views.Installation was streamlined & efficient with polite tradesmen who left the site spotless.Connection to the grid was performed by the company as was the setup of the monitoring app.Highly recommended!
Spark innovations designed a system and promptly implemented it, punctually and courteously would recommend very highly
Very professional, prompt and knowledgeable.Discussed the various options and took the time to explain everything and the pros and cons.

Daniel and his team provided an efficient and quality service installing and commissioning the PV system of my choice. All done to the plan with no fuss. I have no hesitation in recommending Spark Innovation.Colin

From the outset, it was clear that Daniel was passionate about solar energy, his customer relationships and focus on a quality electrical installation. Not for him any slick sales gimmicks or incentives, just a thoroughly professional, considered and helpful approach to dealing with the many queries we raised as potential solar customers. His installation team were similarly enthusiastic, conscientious and tidy in their demeanor and approach to the actual installation. Throughout the process, Daniel maintained regular contact, advising on next steps and responding to any last minute queries. The system we chose was good value for money with flexibility in our choice of componentry and Daniel handled all the supplier paperwork on our behalf. The Spark proposal also included regular system follow up and cleaning, which we considered to be a valuable feature of their offer.All in all, an extremely satisfactory experience and we would have no hesitation in recommending Daniel and his efficient Spark Innovation team to anyone seeking a high quality, PV electrical installation.
